mapper.select: select A.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, /*质押金融产品代码*/ A.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE, /*质押面值*/ A.PLEDGE_NUMBER, /*质押数量*/ A.PLEDGE_RATIO, /*质押率*/ A.PLEDGE_AMT /*质押金额*/ FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE A INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F02','F03','F04','F05')

select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, /*金融产品代码*/ A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, /*金融产品类型*/ A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodTypeCode, /*金融产品类型Code*/ A.PRIN as prin, /*名义本金*/ A.CCY as ccy, /*本金币种*/ to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as vdate1, /*起息日*/ to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as mdate1, /*到期日*/ A.TERM as term, /*期限(天)*/ A.TERM_TYPE as termType, /*期限品种*/ A.INT_TYPE as intType, /*利率类型*/ A.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, /*固定利率*/ A.INT_RATE_ID as intRateId, /* 利率编号*/ A.BASIS as basis, /*计息基础*/ A.M_PRIN_AMT as mPrinAmt, /*到期本金*/ A.M_INT_AMT as mIntAmt, /*到期利息*/ A.M_TRADE_AMT as mTradeAmt, /*到期金额*/ A.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, /*交易场所*/ A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, /*本金收益特征*/ A.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, /*交易日历*/ B.CALENDAR_NAME as calendarName, /*交易日历名称*/ a.contract_no contractNo,/*合同编号*/ to_char(a.vpay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') vpayDate ,/*首期交付日*/ to_char(a.mpay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate ,/*到期交付日*/ a.act_cap_days actCapDays, /*实际占宽天数*/ c.se_rep_day_type seRepDayType,/*交易所回购计提天数方式*/ c.se_rep_day_type seRepDayTypeCode /*交易所回购计提天数方式*/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO B ON B.CALENDAR_ID = A.CALENDAR_ID left join fin_product_valuation_para c on a.finprod_id=c.finprod_id and a.branch=c.branch WHERE (A.BRANCH = 0 OR A.BRANCH is null) AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
SELECT distinct A.CALENDAR_ID id, A.CALENDAR_NAME text FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO A ORDER BY A.CALENDAR_ID desc
